Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

Cancel's visible and accessible text remains the bare action label; the status-bar test asserts exactly 'Cancel'.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/shell/JobsChip.scala:88 assigns cancel accessible text a.label
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/shell/StatusBarFxSuite.scala:194 asserts accessible text is 'Cancel'

Remaining / next action: Carry run/job identity in ActionVM and shell/status-bar accessible names, with an accessibility regression test.

Disposition: Keep open.
